summary_en: The caller contacted the agent but stated they were busy and requested to be called back later. The agent acknowledged the request, saved the caller's details, and agreed to arrange a follow-up call from the support team. The call concluded with the agent thanking the caller and saying goodbye.
next_action: Callback required from support team as requested by the caller.
objections: Caller stated they are busy right now and asked to be called back later.
notes: The caller did not reject the offer entirely but deferred the conversation. The agent did not promise a specific callback time, only that the request was saved.

lead_assessment.note: Priority score uses recorded business signals; it is not a conversion probability or contact consent.
